purpose: Failure-driven policy hardening after inspecting the immutable v1 formal result.
interpretation_limits: This is not a held-out or pre-registered confirmatory evaluation.
The model is not rerun; all 96 immutable v1 raw outputs are replayed once through the revised policy.
v1 remains the sole formal headline result and is never overwritten.
v2 must not report a new confirmatory p-value or claim production generalization.

policy_invariants.rule: adjustUp and adjustDown require user-authored evidence for that exact direction; directionless adjust always requires clarification.
A model-proposed room, floor, or device selector absent from the registry cannot filter candidates; it is erased, recorded unresolved, and forces clarification without guessed ontology mappings.
For a deictic request with session context, candidates originate from the referenced context; model-only domain and attribute guesses cannot exclude those entities.

non_goals: No base-ID, upstairs/downstairs, Dining Light, or other example-specific branches or aliases.
No weakening of answer-supported source-plan patching.
The context-reference case whose answer supplies only a target but not the model-missed operation must continue to fail closed.
No iteration on v2 after reading its full replay score.
